title_boundary.meaning: The title is preserved as a provocative archival/myth-buster label and a request to avoid unsupported psychiatric labeling of Stanislaus Braun.
not_claiming: The artifact does not erase Braun's coercive, cruel, manipulative or lethal behavior inside Tranquility Lane.
The artifact does not diagnose or exonerate Braun clinically.
The artifact does not claim that causing simulated suffering is morally harmless.
The artifact does not claim Braun is benevolent merely because he is the system administrator.

myth_under_test.hypothesis: After the apparent exit from Tranquility Lane, James and the Lone Wanderer remain inside a more advanced second Braun simulation and all subsequent Fallout 3 events are generated by Braun.
myth_under_test.reason: Fallout 3's own quest and container scripts explicitly transition the player out of the Tranquility Lane state and back to physical Vault 112 state. No positive shipped evidence was found for a second Braun-controlled simulation encompassing the remainder of Fallout 3.

mq04_state.exit_behavior: PlayerInTL is explicitly reset when leaving Tranquility Lane.
physical_restore_actions: player is returned to the physical Vault 112 pod location
real Pip-Boy and inventory are restored
GNR and Enclave Radio are re-enabled
the player's physical pod is opened
James's ghost/perma-unconscious state is removed for physical interaction

shipped_script_boundary.authorial_model: The shipped game code treats Tranquility Lane and physical Vault 112 as separate states with an explicit transition between them.
shipped_script_boundary.epistemic_ceiling: This is strong evidence for the intended game-world model, not a philosophical proof that nested simulation is logically impossible.

nested_simulation_result.required_extra_assumption: The hypothesis requires Braun to possess and deploy an undocumented simulation capable of reproducing the entire 2277 Capital Wasteland, factions, radio systems, independent NPCs, Vaults and later events after MQ04.
nested_simulation_result.anti_overfit_rule: A hypothesis that can absorb every contrary observation as another simulation layer is not promoted without an independent positive marker.

confirmed: Braun has privileged administrative control inside Tranquility Lane.
Braun's physical body remains in a Vault 112 lounger and is machine-supported.
Betty is Braun's simulation avatar rather than established independent uploaded AI.
Pod/system exceptions protect Braun from the same termination path available for other subjects.
Braun controls simulation scenarios, memory handling and participant roles to an extraordinary degree.
not_established: Braun is an independent AI without a biological body.
Betty can continue autonomously after physical Braun dies.
Braun controls all events after the player exits Vault 112.
Braun offers James literal immortality as a documented shipped dialogue proposition.

confirmed_core: James deliberately sought Braun's research for Project Purity.
James did not expect Braun to still be alive.
James entered Tranquility Lane and was trapped by Braun.
Braun describes James as unwilling to compromise and unwilling to do what Braun asked.
James refused to participate in Braun's games.
Braun reduced James's agency by assigning him the dog avatar Doc.
james_braun_conflict.interpretive_compression: BRAUN ASSERTS CONTROL OVER HIS CREATED WORLD; JAMES REJECTS CONTROL AS MORAL AUTHORITY.

fatherhood_lesson_hypothesis.hypothesis: Braun intentionally constructed the remainder of Fallout 3 as a second simulation to teach James what it means to be a father.
fatherhood_lesson_hypothesis.interesting_residue: Tranquility Lane itself does create a father-child moral trial: James is immobilized and transformed, while the Lone Wanderer must decide whether to obey Braun's harmful tasks or break the system through the hidden failsafe.

behavioral_findings: Braun repeatedly manipulates inhabitants' memories and identities.
Braun repeatedly subjects inhabitants to suffering for his own purposes and entertainment.
Braun coerces newcomers into harmful tasks and punishes refusal by restricting agency.
The Chinese Invasion failsafe can terminate physical subjects, while Braun's own system exception protects him.
allowed_precise_language: cruel behavior documented in shipped content
privileged simulation administrator with lethal control
braun_moral_label_audit.forbidden_overclaim: Do not convert fictional behavior into a real-world psychiatric diagnosis without explicit canonical diagnosis and clinical criteria.
braun_moral_label_audit.artifact_title_interpretation: 'BRAUN IS NOT A SADIST' is preserved as a challenge to lazy diagnostic labeling, not as a denial of documented cruelty.

two_faces.virtual: child avatar Betty with near-total administrative control

duality: WEAK PHYSICAL AGENCY <-> EXTREME VIRTUAL AUTHORITY

ru: Код игры проводит явную границу: Tranquility Lane заканчивается, физический Vault 112 начинается.
Гипотеза о том, что весь дальнейший Fallout 3 является второй симуляцией Braun, отвергается как не имеющая положительного shipped-доказательства.
Braun — системный администратор Tranquility Lane с чрезвычайными привилегиями, но административная власть не является доказательством права определять моральную истину.
Название 'BRAUN IS NOT A SADIST' защищает точность языка: жестокое поведение подтверждено, клинический диагноз — нет.
Не нужно оправдывать Braun, чтобы отказаться от неподтверждённого психиатрического ярлыка.
en: The shipped game code draws an explicit boundary: Tranquility Lane ends and physical Vault 112 resumes.
The hypothesis that the remainder of Fallout 3 is Braun's second simulation is rejected for lack of positive shipped evidence.
Braun is the privileged system administrator of Tranquility Lane, but administrative power does not establish moral authority.
The title 'BRAUN IS NOT A SADIST' protects precision of language: cruel behavior is documented; a clinical diagnosis is not.
Rejecting an unsupported psychiatric label does not require moral exoneration of Braun.
